query.name: ca.myblueprint.dem.conedsections
query.description: Continuing Education course sections with term and enrolment
query.sql: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT '' AS coned_school_ids FROM dual ), yr AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) - CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM')) < 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END - 1990 AS yearid FROM dual ) SELECT TO_CHAR(s.SCHOOLID) AS a_SchoolID ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(sc.NAME, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS b_SchoolName ,s.COURSE_NUMBER AS c_CourseNumber ,s.SECTION_NUMBER AS d_SectionNumber ,TO_CHAR(s.TERMID) AS e_TermID ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(t.NAME, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS f_TermName ,TO_CHAR(s.NO_OF_STUDENTS) AS g_NoOfStudents ,TO_CHAR(s.MAXENROLLMENT) AS h_MaxEnrollment FROM SECTIONS s LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN yr ON 1=1 INNER JOIN SCHOOLS sc ON sc.SCHOOL_NUMBER = s.SCHOOLID INNER JOIN TERMS t ON t.ID = s.TERMID AND t.SCHOOLID = s.SCHOOLID WHERE cfg.coned_school_ids IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.coned_school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || s.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0 AND t.YEARID IN (yr.yearid, yr.yearid + 1) ORDER BY s.SCHOOLID, s.COURSE_NUMBER, s.SECTION_NUMBER
